name: Froxel Grid Construction
definition: A real-time clustered lighting and volumetrics system for Unreal Engine 5 that partitions the view frustum into a 3D grid of voxels (froxels) to efficiently assign lights to spatial regions.
summary: Froxel Grid Construction partitions the view frustum into a 3D grid to organize lights for volumetric scattering, differing from standard clustered lighting by targeting participating media and excluding non-volumetric lights.
